title: Fossil Finder A-Z
hook: Brush the stone, let the old clue show!
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: warm 3D fossil-and-bones storybook, sandy museum dig palette, friendly specimens, clean separable foregrounds

creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: two-line memory anchor whose orchestration changes on repeat
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: Round 1 alternates stomp-sized short entries with longer fossil or body-shape clues; do not call every prehistoric animal a dinosaur when it is a pterosaur or marine reptile.
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: Round 2 uses footprint-sized recall gaps and safe stomp, trace, tail or fossil-brush pantomime after the answer.
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: low soft tom footprint plus wooden click, never a scary roar over the word.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: low soft tom footprint plus wooden click, never a scary roar over the word
